006package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.library;
007
008import java.time.ZoneId;
009import java.time.ZoneOffset;
010import java.time.ZonedDateTime;
011import java.util.List;
012import java.util.Objects;
013
014import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.DynamicContext;
015import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.MetapathConstants;
016import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.FunctionUtils;
017import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IArgument;
018import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IFunction;
019import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.InvalidArgumentFunctionException;
020import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.IItem;
021import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.ISequence;
022import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IDateItem;
023import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IDateTimeItem;
024import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.ITimeItem;
025import dev.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
026import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
027import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
028
029/**
030 * Implements the XPath 3.1 <a href=
031 * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-dateTime">fn:dateTime</a>
032 * function.
033 */
034public final class FnDateTime {
035  @NonNull
036  private static final String NAME = "dateTime";
037  @NonNull
038  static final IFunction SIGNATURE = IFunction.builder()
039      .name(NAME)
040      .namespace(MetapathConstants.NS_METAPATH_FUNCTIONS)
041      .deterministic()
042      .contextIndependent()
043      .focusIndependent()
044      .argument(IArgument.builder()
045          .name("date")
046          .type(IDateItem.type())
047          .zeroOrOne()
048          .build())
049      .argument(IArgument.builder()
050          .name("time")
051          .type(ITimeItem.type())
052          .zeroOrOne()
053          .build())
054      .returnType(IDateTimeItem.type())
055      .returnOne()
056      .functionHandler(FnDateTime::execute)
057      .build();
058
059  private FnDateTime() {
060    // disable construction
061  }
062
063  @SuppressWarnings("unused")
064  @NonNull
065  private static ISequence<IDateTimeItem> execute(@NonNull IFunction function,
066      @NonNull List<ISequence<?>> arguments,
067      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext,
068      IItem focus) {
069    IDateItem date = FunctionUtils.asTypeOrNull(arguments.get(0).getFirstItem(true));
070    ITimeItem time = FunctionUtils.asTypeOrNull(arguments.get(1).getFirstItem(true));
071
072    return ISequence.of(fnDateTimeOfNullable(date, time));
073  }
074
075  /**
076   * Create a date/time item from the provided date and time values.
077   * <p>
078   * Implements the XPath 3.1 <a href=
079   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-current-date">fn:current-date</a>
080   * function.
081   *
082   * @param date
083   *          the date value to get the year, month, and day from or {@code null}
084   * @param time
085   *          the time value to get the hour, minute, seconds from or {@code null}
086   * @return the data/time value composed of the provided date and time values or
087   *         {@code null} if either date or time value is {@code null}
088   */
089  @Nullable
090  public static IDateTimeItem fnDateTimeOfNullable(@Nullable IDateItem date, @Nullable ITimeItem time) {
091    return date == null || time == null
092        ? null
093        : fnDateTime(date, time);
094  }
095
096  /**
097   * Create a date/time item from the provided date and time values.
098   * <p>
099   * Implements the XPath 3.1 <a href=
100   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-current-date">fn:current-date</a>
101   * function.
102   *
103   * @param date
104   *          the date value to get the year, month, and day from
105   * @param time
106   *          the time value to get the hour, minute, seconds from
107   * @return the data/time value composed of the provided date and time values
108   */
109  @NonNull
110  public static IDateTimeItem fnDateTime(@NonNull IDateItem date, @NonNull ITimeItem time) {
111    ZoneId timezone = getTimezone(
112        date.hasTimezone() ? date.asZonedDateTime().getZone() : null,
113        time.hasTimezone() ? time.asOffsetTime().getOffset().normalized() : null);
114    ZonedDateTime dateTime = ObjectUtils.notNull(ZonedDateTime.of(
115        date.asLocalDate(),
116        time.asLocalTime(),
117        timezone == null ? ZoneOffset.UTC : timezone));
118    return IDateTimeItem.valueOf(dateTime, timezone != null);
119  }
120
121  @Nullable
122  private static ZoneId getTimezone(ZoneId dateZoneId, ZoneId timeZoneId) {
123    ZoneId retval;
124    if (Objects.equals(dateZoneId, timeZoneId) || dateZoneId != null && timeZoneId == null) {
125      retval = dateZoneId;
126    } else if (dateZoneId == null && timeZoneId != null) {
127      retval = timeZoneId;
128    } else {
129      throw new InvalidArgumentFunctionException(
130          InvalidArgumentFunctionException.DATE_TIME_INCONSISTENT_TIMEZONE,
131          String.format("The date ('%s') and time ('%s') timezones are inconsistent.",
132              dateZoneId == null ? "<none>" : dateZoneId.getId(),
133              timeZoneId == null ? "<none>" : timeZoneId.getId()));
134    }
135    return retval;
136  }
137}
